journey.name: wear receive paid
journey.description:
Paying the receive QR's invoice turns the QR into a check with the amount, with a firm haptic; a tap on the check shows a new invoice. This also funds the wallet for the send journeys. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: a wallet restored on the local ./spark stack, see journeys/wear/README.md › Local ./spark stack: the Restored wallet (README › Restored wallet), or the Private settings wallet (README › Private settings wallet) when this funds it for the settings and QuickPay journeys. Either way the phone's settings of that wallet are still the defaults, Bitcoin first and Denomination Modern, so the paid amount reads in sats: on the private wallet run this before any settings journey, since under Classic the same amount reads "0.00050000". The app is on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped. Gestures are written for the 454 px screen. The haptic cannot be checked over adb; feel it on a physical watch.

actions.action: Swipe the pager left once: `adb shell input swipe 400 227 60 227 300`
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr" (README, top)
Read the invoice from the log as in README › Reading the receive invoice and note it as <invoice>
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark pay <invoice> 50000` from this repo's parent checkout
Wait up to 20 s until "WatchReceivePaid" is listed
Wait up to 10 s until `adb shell uiautomator dump` lists "WatchReceiveQr"
Read the invoice from the log again as <next>
